title: ASELSAN's EJDERHA Neutralises 51 Drones Launched Simultaneously Within Seconds
excerpt: On its 51st anniversary ASELSAN used the EJDERHA high-power electromagnetic (HPEM) system to defeat 51 simultaneously launched drones within seconds, after first downing two tethered drones at about 1,000 metres.
rank_math_title: EJDERHA downs 51 drones at once: ASELSAN HPEM world record | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: ASELSAN's EJDERHA HPEM counter-drone system neutralised 51 simultaneously launched drones within seconds without using munitions. Tethered drone test, Akyol's remarks and how the system works.
